name: print-to-markdown
description: Chrome extension: save, copy or send the current page as Markdown from the print dialog, toolbar, context menu or a shortcut.

scripts.zip: sh scripts/vendor.sh && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/print-to-markdown.zip && (cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/print-to-markdown.zip .)
scripts.lint: node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/content/convert.js && node --check extension/lib/*.js
